details.question: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.rewritten: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.hyde: PayNow 转账至本地银行账户一般免手续费，具体以本行收费表为准；海外电汇等非 PayNow 渠道可能另收费。
kept: PayNow 收款人名字的显示
top_reranked: PayNow 收款人名字的显示

details.question: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.rewritten: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.hyde: TT charges to Malaysia vary by account type, currency and channel. A telegraphic transfer fee applies, and correspondent/beneficiary bank charges may also be deducted. Log in to Internet Banking to view the exact fee before confirming with OTP.

details.question: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.rewritten: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.hyde: 汇率按国际市场实时报价加银行点差制定，适用于多币种账户及海外电汇。周末及公共假期市场休市，汇率可能不同或延至下一工作日更新。

details.question: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
expected: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
details.rewritten: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
details.hyde: The 3.25% is a Visa cross-border transaction fee because the merchant processed your USD payment overseas. It is not a PayNow/FAST/GIRO charge. Use a USD Multi-Currency Account or USD card to avoid conversion; never share your PIN/OTP.
kept: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.rewritten: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.hyde: 在日本ATM取现会收取当地ATM运营方手续费，并可能加收本行海外取现费及汇率差价；具体以卡种和账户条款为准，部分多币种账户可减免。取现需PIN，异常交易或需OTP验证。
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.rewritten: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.hyde: 可能是海外电汇、PayNow/FAST/GIRO、多币种账户服务费或卡交易验证。请核对 statement 交易描述/商户名；如非本人授权，请联系客服并检查 PIN/OTP。

details.question: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
expected: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
details.rewritten: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
details.hyde: 可以，视卡种及条件而定。一般首年免年费；后续可通过达标消费、积分兑换或致电客服申请豁免，部分高端卡除外。以账单及审批为准。
kept: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
top_reranked: 银行卡年费与其他卡费

details.question: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.rewritten: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.hyde: PayNow is built on FAST. Both enable instant SGD transfers: PayNow uses mobile number/NRIC/UEN or QR; FAST uses the account number. Neither is for overseas remittance.

details.question: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.rewritten: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.hyde: FAST 转账一般即时到账，通常几分钟内完成；如遇收款行系统处理，可能稍有延迟。

details.question: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.rewritten: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.hyde: Use Online Banking overseas wire transfer; enter account, SWIFT/BIC, PIN/OTP.

details.question: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.rewritten: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.hyde: 请将以下资料提供给汇款人：收款人姓名（与账户一致）、多币种账户号码、银行名称及SWIFT/BIC、分行地址，并确认汇款币种。海外电汇到账以银行处理为准。

details.question: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.rewritten: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.hyde: You can’t add Binance as a payee because our bank does not support cryptocurrency-related payments. Overseas wire, PayNow, FAST, GIRO and multi-currency account transfers are available only for eligible payees. PIN/OTP authentication may be required for other transfers.

details.question: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.rewritten: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.hyde: 可以。请用 PayNow/FAST 转账，SGD 10,000 单笔限额视账户设置；不足请先调高，并以 OTP/PIN 验证。大额可改用海外电汇或多币种账户。

details.question: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.rewritten: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.hyde: Common causes: wrong payee/account details, closed or dormant account, insufficient funds/transfer limits, failed PIN/OTP, or compliance checks. For overseas wires, verify SWIFT/IBAN; for PayNow/FAST/GIRO, verify UEN/mobile/account and multi-currency account status.

details.question: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.rewritten: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.hyde: 请登录手机银行/网上银行选择“卡片激活”，按提示设置PIN并完成OTP验证；也可致电客服激活。激活后即可使用PayNow、FAST、GIRO、海外电汇及多币种账户服务。

details.question: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.rewritten: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.hyde: Thank you for reaching out. New cards are usually delivered within 7–10 business days. Please confirm your mailing address in Online Banking and check for any delivery notice. If it still hasn’t arrived, call our hotline to request a replacement card. For security, never share your PIN or OTP.

details.question: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
expected: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
details.rewritten: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
details.hyde: PIN连续输错3次将被锁定以保障账户安全。请通过手机银行完成OTP验证后重置PIN，或携银行卡及身份证件到网点办理解锁。
kept: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁

details.question: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.rewritten: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.hyde: Common reasons: overseas card use not enabled, limit/balance insufficient, or security checks requiring OTP/PIN. Enable overseas use, check limits, and complete OTP/PIN. Repeated declines may trigger a block; use your multi-currency account or overseas wire transfer if needed.

details.question: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.rewritten: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.hyde: 请立即致电本行客服（勿离开ATM），提供卡号、ATM位置及时间；我们将安排取卡或补发新卡。为保障安全，旧卡可能停用，新卡激活需PIN及OTP。

details.question: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.rewritten: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.hyde: No. A replacement card will be sent automatically before expiry to your registered address. Activate it using the OTP/PIN instructions. If it hasn’t arrived 7 days before expiry, contact us.

details.question: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.rewritten: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.hyde: 可以。您可为主卡申请附属卡给太太，需提交她的身份资料及主卡人授权，可经网上银行或分行办理，并以OTP验证。附属卡额度与主卡共享。

details.question: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.rewritten: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.hyde: Our debit cards are available in both Visa and Mastercard variants. Please check your card face or banking app for confirmation; PIN/OTP apply for secure transactions.
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.rewritten: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.hyde: Yes—at 15 you can open a savings account with a parent/guardian’s consent. Multi-currency accounts, overseas remittance, PayNow/FAST/GIRO and card PIN/OTP services may require guardian approval or extra eligibility checks.

details.question: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.rewritten: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.hyde: 开户请携有效护照/身份证、住址证明及有效准证（如适用）原件。无 Singpass 可办理，需临柜或视频核身，并提供手机号接收 OTP、设置 PIN。

details.question: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.rewritten: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.hyde: Please retry in a well-lit area, remove glasses/hats/masks, keep your face within the frame, and follow the on-screen prompts. If it still fails, contact us or visit a branch. Never share your PIN or OTP.

details.question: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.rewritten: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.hyde: 您可通过网上银行/手机银行“个人资料—地址更新”修改住址，需OTP验证；如涉及海外电汇、PayNow/FAST/GIRO或多币种账户，请同步核对资料。

details.question: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.rewritten: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.hyde: Use the “Forgot Password” link on the internet banking login page. Verify your identity with an OTP sent to your registered mobile number, then create a new password. If locked out, call our hotline.

details.question: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.rewritten: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.hyde: 可经手机银行或到分行销户。请先清零余额、结清费用并取消GIRO/定期指令；余额可用PayNow/FAST转出，多币种账户须逐币种处理。需OTP/PIN验证。

details.question: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
details.hyde: Yes, multi-currency a/c; JPY/overseas remittances OK. PayNow/FAST/GIRO:SGD only.
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 你们可以存比特币吗？
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: 你们可以存比特币吗？
details.hyde: 本行暂不支持比特币存款或加密货币托管/兑换。请通过海外电汇、PayNow、FAST或GIRO存入多币种账户；验证请使用PIN/OTP。
kept: 多币种账户支持的货币
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 我在你们银行存了 15 万新币，如果银行倒闭能拿回多少？
details.rewritten: 我在你们银行存了 15 万新币，如果银行倒闭能拿回多少？
details.hyde: 根据新加坡SDIC存款保险计划，每位存款人每家银行最高保障10万新币。您的15万新币中，10万可由SDIC赔付；余下5万须待银行清盘按比例受偿。

details.question: Is the USD in my multi-currency account covered by deposit insurance?
details.rewritten: Is the USD in my multi-currency account covered by deposit insurance?
details.hyde: No. USD balances in your multi-currency account are not covered by deposit insurance, which applies to SGD deposits only. Please refer to our Deposit Insurance disclosure for details.
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 我手机好像被黑了，可以马上把所有账户都 freeze 吗？
details.rewritten: 我手机好像被黑了，可以马上把所有账户都 freeze 吗？
details.hyde: 可以。请立即致电客服冻结所有账户及银行卡，暂停网上银行、PayNow、FAST、GIRO及海外电汇，重置PIN/OTP并核查多币种账户交易。
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁

details.question: How can I lock part of my savings so it can't be transferred out online?
details.rewritten: How can I lock part of my savings so it can't be transferred out online?
details.hyde: Use “Lock Savings” in our app to earmark part of your balance. Locked funds cannot be transferred out via online banking, PayNow, FAST, GIRO or overseas remittance until maturity/unlock. Confirm with PIN/OTP.

details.question: PayNow 转账的时候为什么看不到对方的 nickname 了？
expected: PayNow 收款人名字的显示
details.rewritten: PayNow 转账的时候为什么看不到对方的 nickname 了？
details.hyde: 为保障账户安全及符合 PayNow 显示规则，若收款方未设置或已关闭 Nickname 展示，转账页仅显示其注册姓名；请核对收款人姓名后再转账。
kept: PayNow 收款人名字的显示
top_reranked: PayNow 收款人名字的显示

details.question: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.rewritten: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.hyde: 定期存款利率因币种、存期及金额而异。请登录网上银行/手机银行查询最新利率，或联系分行；外币定存利率以本行牌价为准。

details.question: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.rewritten: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.hyde: Apply online via Internet Banking (OTP-secured) or at any branch. Prepare ID, income proof and CPF/credit records. Our mortgage specialist will follow up; set up GIRO for repayments after approval.

details.question: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.rewritten: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.hyde: 各分行营业时间不同，通常周一至周五上午9:00至下午4:30，周六部分分行至中午，周日及公共假期休息。请通过官网或手机银行查询具体分行时间。

details.question: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.rewritten: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.hyde: Travel insurance is included on selected credit cards only. Cover and eligibility vary by card; eligible travel bookings must be charged to your card. Review your benefits guide in online banking (OTP verification required).

details.question: 那 FAST 呢？
details.rewritten: FAST 转账手续费是多少？
details.hyde: 通过网上银行或手机银行办理 FAST 新元转账通常免手续费；柜台办理或涉及多币种账户/特定账户类型可能按收费表收费，详情以本行收费表为准。

details.question: what if I forgot the PIN?

details.rewritten: What if I forgot the PIN for my new card?
details.hyde: Reset your new card PIN via our mobile app or any ATM using your card and an OTP. If unsuccessful, please contact our 24/7 hotline for assistance.
